structured.answer: With 500 ₪ a month, after 8 years I'd have about 68,853 ₪ ("נשאר בידיים"). For 4 years the calculator has no figure for self-employed people. It just says "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים" and that you pay tax if you take the money out early.

stuck.why: The only big number was 25,725. At first I took it for my fund. It's actually the 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך' column, and the fund itself showed an empty dashed bar and orange text
It opens on שכירים with salary and employer % fields. I had to notice the עצמאים toggle myself

used: orange note about withdrawing before 6 years
skipped: rest of the guide below the calculator
tabs 'שווה לדעת' and 'מי מציע ומי מצטרף'

findings.what: For 4 years the only number on screen is 25,725, which belongs to the comparison account. You can easily take it as the fund's result
findings.where: result chart when slider is before year 6

findings.what: For self-employed there's no number before 6 years, only an orange note. That's exactly when I'd want to know how much I lose
Calculator opens on שכירים by default, and the עצמאים option is easy to miss
The chart has many columns and colours, and 'החזר המס הוסיף' and 'המס לקח 0' aren't explained next to them
Not clear if 68,853 is in today's money or not; it says 'אחרי החזר המס'
